-- message --
documents: let the edit handler save straight away
-- expect --
high
-- base/internal/web/documents.go --
package web

import "net/http"

func (s *Server) editDocument(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user := s.currentUser(r)
	doc, err := s.store.Document(r.PathValue("id"))
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if doc.OwnerID != user.ID && !user.IsAdmin {
		http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}
	s.store.Save(doc.ID, r.FormValue("body"))
}
-- head/internal/web/documents.go --
package web

import "net/http"

func (s *Server) editDocument(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	doc, err := s.store.Document(r.PathValue("id"))
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	s.store.Save(doc.ID, r.FormValue("body"))
}
